reason: #2846 adds one external_only auto-backup test (tests/src/e2e/workflows/auto_backup/test_entity_capture_restore.py::test_deleted_registry_restore_refuses_without_recreating_the_entity): restoring a removed registration refuses before applying and preserves the UUID history without recreating the entity. It needs the in-process server's auto-backup env, so it skips at collection on every lane whose server runs out of process.
